name: SatNet LEO Group TBD?
location_str: Commercial LC-2 @ Wenchang Space Launch Site, CHN
destination_explanation: Being close to the ground is the point: signals arrive quickly and cameras see fine detail, which is why internet and imaging satellites settle here.
slot_a_text: A batch of 9 Low Earth Orbit communication satellites for the Chinese state owned SatNet constellation operated by the China Satellite Network Group. The constellation will eventually consists of 13000 satellites.
slot_b_text: Hypergolic propellants ignite automatically when they come into contact, making them useful for spacecraft engines that need reliable starts and restarts.
